item.title: Marsha Blackburn: Here’s how Republicans are tackling rising crime
item.description: Under the Biden administration, crime soared—especially among violent offenders. Between 2020 and 2023, the per capita violent crime rate increased by 55 percent, according to the Bureau of Justice Statistics, which recorded significant increases in rape, robbery, and aggravated assault.
